name: Quality & Safety in Construction
description: Introduction to safety and quality management in construction projects, safety terminologies, strategic planning, personnel and structural safety during construction, demolition, and equipment handling, along with recording injuries, accident statistics, and violations, quality tools like QFD, inspection techniques, TQM, six sigma, and ISO certifications, quality and safety method statements, SOPs, PPE usage, site safety programs, and investigations, construction leadership and communication, implementation of safety measures and quality control strategies, fostering excellence in construction project management.
